title: SLI decomposition and soft-fallback leasing playbook for per-model endpoints
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a canonical, implementation-ready playbook for decomposing SLIs per endpoint and model variant, assigning error-budget leasing rules across regions, and specifying graduated circuit-breaker / soft-fallback behavior for low-latency and high-throughput routes. This ticket produces the policy document, telemetry mappings, example alert rules, and a reference implementor checklist for routing and the orchestration layer.
background: Recent incidents (see postmortem linked below) showed that blunt per-endpoint SLIs caused disproportionate eviction of premium model variants during regional bursts. We need a repeatable decomposition that: attributes SLI credit to model variants and routes, supports short-term 'borrowing' (lease) of error budget across regions, and defines graded circuit-breaker thresholds with hysteresis to avoid flapping. This is targeted at hosted and dedicated modes and must be implementable in the smart router and runtime admission controller.
goals: Define SLI decomposition rules: availability, tail-latency (p95/p99), and quality (model-specific metrics) per endpoint + variant
Define error-budget 'leasing' semantics between regions and pinned variants (duration, repayment rules, limits)
Specify graduated circuit-breaker profiles with hysteresis and soft-fallback actions (variant substitution, degrade policy, queueing)
Produce telemetry query examples (PromQL / Datadog) and example alerting thresholds
Provide rollout checklist, tests, and a small simulation harness to validate burn scenarios
acceptance_criteria: Policy doc reviewed and approved by Reliability and Runtime leads
PromQL/Datadog templates map to existing metrics and surface expected SLI metrics in Console
Router admission controller implements leasing API; e2e test demonstrating cross-region lease and repayment
Canary roll with traffic shape that exercises degrade bands without user-visible errors in >95% of test runs
decisions: Use three degradation bands (green/yellow/red) per endpoint with configurable thresholds: green=OK, yellow=grace degrade, red=hard circuit open
Attribute quality SLI to model variant at token-level: quality_score per response averaged over request-weighted tokens
Allow region-to-region leasing with max concurrent leased percentage defaulting to 10% of local error budget and 30-minute max lease duration
Implement circuit hysteresis: open after sustained red for 3m, half-open after 5m probation, repay required lease before full restore
Soft-fallback sequence: variant-substitute (cheaper quantized variant) -> reduced max tokens -> increased regeneration retries disabled
notes: Quality SLI is intentionally model-specific; for open models we use promptset-based quality estimates (A/B eval harness), for proprietary models use embedding-similarity + hallucination detectors
Token-weighted attribution avoids penalizing low-cost short requests when a burst of long requests consumes backend capacity
Leasing requires a compact ledger service; initial implementation will piggyback on existing regional quota service with a small extension
We must add safeguards to avoid cascading leases (circular borrowing) — ledger will track provenance and disallow chained leases beyond 1 hop
implementation_plan: Draft policy doc and SLI mapping (this ticket)
Instrument Prometheus / Datadog queries and add sample dashboard panels (observability)
Extend router admission API to accept lease tokens and annotate routed requests
Runtime: admission controller enforces degrade bands and triggers variant substitution path
Integration tests: simulate regional surge, assert lease repayment behavior and circuit hysteresis
Canary: deploy to limited endpoints and monitor Console dashboards; iterate thresholds
risk_and_mitigations: Risk: Overly aggressive leasing causes systemic underprovisioning. Mitigation: cap leases and require repayment before full restore; run dry-run simulations
Risk: Variant substitution may degrade customer experience. Mitigation: prefer quantized variant with prior quality validation and add a 'do-not-substitute' label for sensitive endpoints
Risk: Complexity in billing/metrics attribution. Mitigation: emit rich tracing annotations and reconcile via nightly job
